grammar_title: 现在进行时的被动语态(is/are being done)
source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 2 Discovering Useful Structures:现在进行时的被动语态(am/is/are being + 过去分词),表示动作此刻正在被进行。句子地道、答案唯一(其余选项同时态家族但形式不成立)。

points.point: 肯定句 am/is/are being + 过去分词
points.overview: 主语是动作的承受者、动作此刻正在被进行时,用 am/is/are being + 过去分词。单数主语用 is being done,复数主语用 are being done。

points.point: 否定与一般疑问(isn't/aren't being done; Is/Are ... being done?)
points.overview: 否定在 be 后加 not:isn't/aren't being done;一般疑问把 be 提到主语前:Is/Are + 主语 + being + 过去分词?

points.point: 主动↔被动转换 · by 短语 · 与一般现在被动(is done)对照
points.overview: 主动句变被动时,正在进行的动作用 are being done,by 引出动作执行者;区分'此刻正在被做'(is being done)与'经常被做/客观事实'(is done)。

questions.stem: Right now, small birds ____ with nets in the wetland.
questions.explanation: 主语 birds 是动作承受者、动作此刻正在被进行 → are being caught。

questions.stem: Look! Wild ducks ____ at the food market over there.
questions.explanation: ducks 被卖、此刻正在进行 → are being sold。

questions.stem: At this moment, the wetland ____ by careless visitors.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 wetland 被破坏、正在进行 → is being destroyed。

questions.stem: Now some parts of the forest ____ with new houses.
questions.explanation: parts 被覆盖、正在进行 → are being covered。

questions.stem: African elephants ____ for their tusks at this very moment.
questions.explanation: elephants 被捕猎、正在进行 → are being hunted。

questions.stem: Listen! A plan ____ to increase the number of wild tigers.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 plan 被执行、正在进行 → is being carried out。

questions.stem: These days, new reserves ____ for the river dolphins.
questions.explanation: reserves 被建造、当前正在进行 → are being built。

questions.stem: Right now, the deer ____ over by many volunteers.
questions.explanation: deer 被看护、正在进行 → are being watched。

questions.stem: At present, the rivers ____ up by local students.
questions.explanation: rivers 被清理、正在进行 → are being cleaned。

questions.stem: Be careful! Some trees near the lake ____ down to make paper.
questions.explanation: trees 被砍、正在进行 → are being cut。

questions.stem: At the moment, a special device ____ deep in the snowy forest.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 device 被测试、正在进行 → is being tested。

questions.stem: Now wolverines ____ by scientists to learn how to protect them.
questions.explanation: wolverines 被研究、正在进行 → are being studied。

questions.stem: Right now, bridges and gates ____ to keep the antelopes safe.
questions.explanation: bridges and gates 被增设、正在进行 → are being added。

questions.stem: Living spaces for wildlife ____ because of the cutting of trees these days.
questions.explanation: spaces 被缩减、正在进行 → are being reduced。

questions.stem: At this moment, fish and snakes ____ for food in some restaurants.
questions.explanation: fish and snakes 被杀、正在进行 → are being killed。

questions.stem: Now paper cut-outs ____ on the windows to protect the birds.
questions.explanation: cut-outs 被贴上、正在进行 → are being put。

questions.stem: These days, the sick whale ____ for by a team of vets.
questions.explanation: whale 被照料、正在进行 → is being cared (for)。

questions.stem: Look! Bird feeders ____ by the club members in the park.
questions.explanation: bird feeders 被搭建、正在进行 → are being built。

questions.stem: At present, the wetland ____ seriously by waste every day.
questions.explanation: wetland 被污染、当前正在进行 → is being polluted。

questions.stem: Right now, the orphan elephants ____ milk from bottles by the keepers.
questions.explanation: elephants 被喂、正在进行 → are being fed。

questions.stem: ____ the rivers being cleaned by the students at the moment?
questions.explanation: 复数主语 rivers 的现在进行被动疑问句,be 提前 → Are ... being cleaned。

questions.stem: Luckily, the rare birds ____ hunted in this reserve any more.
questions.explanation: 鸟未被捕、现在进行被动否定 → aren't being caught。

questions.stem: ____ the new reserve being built for the dolphins right now?
questions.explanation: 单数主语 reserve 的现在进行被动疑问,be 提前 → Is ... being built。

questions.stem: These old trees ____ cut down at present, so the koalas are safe for now.
questions.explanation: 树未被砍、现在进行被动否定 → aren't being cut。

questions.stem: ____ the antelopes being watched over by volunteers these days?
questions.explanation: 复数主语 antelopes 的现在进行被动疑问 → Are ... being watched。

questions.stem: I'm glad the wetland ____ destroyed by builders now.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 wetland 现在进行被动否定 → isn't being destroyed。

questions.stem: ____ enough measures being taken to protect the elephants at present?
questions.explanation: 复数主语 measures 的现在进行被动疑问句,be 提前 → Are ... being taken。

questions.stem: Sadly, the river ____ cleaned at the moment, and rubbish is everywhere.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 river 现在进行被动否定 → isn't being cleaned。

questions.stem: ____ the device being tested in the snowy forest at this moment?
questions.explanation: 单数主语 device 现在进行被动疑问 → Is ... being tested。

questions.stem: The shy animals ____ disturbed by the cameras at present.
questions.explanation: 动物未被打扰、现在进行被动否定 → aren't being disturbed。

questions.stem: ____ paper cut-outs being put on the windows right now to save the birds?
questions.explanation: 复数主语 cut-outs 现在进行被动疑问 → Are ... being put。

questions.stem: The poster ____ designed yet, so we cannot put it up today.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 poster 现在进行被动否定 → isn't being designed。

questions.stem: ____ the orphan elephants being fed by the keepers at the moment?
questions.explanation: 复数主语 elephants 现在进行被动疑问 → Are ... being fed。

questions.stem: These wild ducks ____ sold at the market now, which is good news.
questions.explanation: 鸭未被卖、现在进行被动否定 → aren't being sold。

questions.stem: ____ a special smell being sent out near the cameras right now?
questions.explanation: 单数主语 smell 现在进行被动疑问 → Is ... being sent。

questions.stem: The forest near our school ____ cut down at present, so the birds stay safe.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 forest 现在进行被动否定 → isn't being cut。

questions.stem: ____ the rivers being polluted by the new factory these days?
questions.explanation: 复数主语 rivers 现在进行被动疑问 → Are ... being polluted。

questions.stem: Happily, the deer ____ hunted in the reserve any longer.
questions.explanation: 鹿未被猎、现在进行被动否定 → aren't being hunted。

questions.stem: ____ the wetland being covered with new houses at the moment?
questions.explanation: 单数主语 wetland 现在进行被动疑问 → Is ... being covered。

questions.stem: The baby birds ____ harmed by anyone in this protected area now.
questions.explanation: 鸟未被伤害、现在进行被动否定 → aren't being harmed。

questions.stem: Many trees are being cut down to make paper. → A lot of paper ____ from these trees right now.
questions.explanation: 把进行中的动作改为被动、单数主语 paper → is being made。

questions.stem: Scientists are studying the wolverines. → The wolverines ____ by scientists at present.
questions.explanation: 主动改被动、动作正在进行 → are being studied。

questions.stem: In this reserve, antelopes ____ illegally every year, but right now poachers are quiet.
questions.explanation: '每年(经常)被猎'是反复事实 → 一般现在被动 are hunted,而非正在进行。

questions.stem: Volunteers are searching the wild for the dolphins. → The dolphins ____ for in the wild now.
questions.explanation: 主动改被动、动作正在进行 → are being searched (for)。

questions.stem: Right now, the wetland ____ by careless tourists, not by the local farmers.
questions.explanation: 动作正在进行、by 引出执行者 → is being polluted by …。

questions.stem: Workers are building new bridges for the antelopes. → New bridges ____ by the workers at this moment.
questions.explanation: 主动改被动、动作正在进行 → are being built by …。

questions.stem: Every spring the reserve ____ to visitors, but it is closed for repairs at the moment.
questions.explanation: '每年春天(经常)开放'是惯常事实 → 一般现在被动 is opened。

questions.stem: The keepers are feeding the orphan elephants. → The orphan elephants ____ by the keepers now.
questions.explanation: 主动改被动、动作正在进行 → are being fed by …。

questions.stem: At this very moment, a poster ____ by the students to call for protection.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 poster、动作正在进行 → is being designed。

questions.stem: People are selling wild ducks at the market. → Wild ducks ____ at the market by some people.
questions.explanation: 主动改被动、动作正在进行 → are being sold by …。

questions.stem: Shark fins ____ in many restaurants every day, though no shark is being killed in this bay now.
questions.explanation: '每天(经常)被供应'是反复事实 → 一般现在被动 are served。

questions.stem: The club members are cleaning up the habitats. → The habitats ____ up by the members right now.
questions.explanation: 主动改被动、动作正在进行 → are being cleaned by …。

questions.stem: Look — a new smell ____ near the cameras to attract the shy wolverines.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 smell、动作正在进行 → is being sent out。

questions.stem: A team is carrying out a plan to save the tigers. → A plan ____ out by a team at present.
questions.explanation: 主动改被动、动作正在进行 → is being carried out by …。

questions.stem: Wild animals ____ under national protection by law, and right now new gates are being added.
questions.explanation: '依法(一直)被置于保护之下'是客观规定 → 一般现在被动 are placed。

questions.stem: Local students are recording the bird songs. → The bird songs ____ by local students now.
questions.explanation: 主动改被动、动作正在进行 → are being recorded by …。

questions.stem: At the moment, the injured deer ____ to a safer place by the rangers.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 deer(此处指一只)、动作正在进行 → is being moved。

questions.stem: Hunters are shooting the antelopes for their fur. → The antelopes ____ for their fur by hunters.
questions.explanation: 主动改被动、动作正在进行 → are being shot by …。

questions.stem: Pandas ____ in this base all year round, but no cub is being moved out this week.
questions.explanation: '一年到头(经常)被保护'是惯常事实 → 一般现在被动 are protected。

questions.stem: The authorities are reducing the living spaces by mistake. → The living spaces ____ by the authorities now.
questions.explanation: 主动改被动、动作正在进行 → are being reduced by …。
